Cena · Your privacy

Waitlist privacy

Last updated November 13, 2026

This notice explains how Cena handles information submitted through the public waitlist for diners and restaurant teams.

What we collect and why

When you join, we collect your email address and whether you are joining as a diner or restaurant. You may also leave an optional note of up to 500 characters about anything unclear. Please do not include personal or sensitive information in that note.

We use this information to manage the waitlist, understand launch interest, and email you about priority access when Cena launches in your area and local kitchens are ready to take orders. Optional notes help us improve signup and app explanations.

Storage, sharing, and retention

We store waitlist records using Supabase, our database provider, to operate the waitlist for Cena. We do not sell waitlist information or share it for cross-context behavioral advertising. We plan to keep waitlist records until you unsubscribe or the waitlist closes, then for up to 90 days.

Your choices

You can unsubscribe from launch emails at any time using the unsubscribe link in an email. You can request access to, a copy of, correction to, or deletion of your waitlist information using the form below. We may verify a request using the email address associated with your waitlist signup.

Make a privacy request

Use this form for access, copy, correction, or deletion requests about your waitlist information. Do not include passwords, payment details, or sensitive personal information.

We may contact you to verify the request. Do not include your password.
